import io
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
X=np.load("showcase.npz")["X"]
def roundtrip(img,fmt,**opts):
    buf=io.BytesIO()
    Image.fromarray(img).save(buf,format=fmt,**opts)
    data=buf.getvalue()
    return len(data),np.array(Image.open(io.BytesIO(data)))
png=[roundtrip(z,"PNG") for z in X[:100]]
jpg=[roundtrip(z,"JPEG",quality=75) for z in X[:100]]
share_png=round(sum(n for n,z in png)/X[:100].nbytes,3)
share_jpeg=round(sum(n for n,z in jpg)/X[:100].nbytes,3)
mae_jpeg=round(float(np.abs(np.stack([z for n,z in jpg]).astype(float)-X[:100]).mean()),2)
lossless=bool(np.array_equal(np.stack([z for n,z in png]),X[:100]))
print(share_png,share_jpeg,mae_jpeg,lossless)
expect: Доли размера по100кадрам, MAE в уровнях яркости0..255; PNG lossless=True; JPEG ошибка>0.

import io
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
X=np.load("showcase.npz")["X"]
def roundtrip(img,fmt,**opts):
    buf=io.BytesIO()
    Image.fromarray(img).save(buf,format=fmt,**opts)
    data=buf.getvalue()
    return len(data),np.array(Image.open(io.BytesIO(data)))
masks=((X[:100]<100)*255).astype(np.uint8)
a=[roundtrip(z,"JPEG",quality=90) for z in masks]
b=[roundtrip(z,"PNG") for z in masks]
back=np.stack([z for n,z in a])
share_gray=round(float(((back!=0)&(back!=255)).mean()),3)
share_flipped=round(float(((back>=128)!=(masks>=128)).mean()),3)
jpeg_share=round(sum(n for n,z in a)/masks.nbytes,3)
png_share=round(sum(n for n,z in b)/masks.nbytes,3)
print(share_gray,share_flipped,jpeg_share,png_share)
expect: Доли промежуточных значений и изменённых классов разные; PNG точен, JPEG меняет числа даже если порог класс сохранил.
